high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from CNBC about YouTube launching a pilot program to give terminated creators a "second chance" by allowing them to apply to create a new channel. The headline is written in bold blue text and is accompanied by a small image of the YouTube logo on a black background with two people walking past it. The text below the headline provides more details about the initiative, mentioning that YouTube is offering creators who were banned from the platform a second chance. It also notes that the Google-owned platform announced this on Thursday.
